reports.title: CareTrust REIT Announces Third Quarter 2026 Operating Results; Updates 2026 Guidance

guidance.heading: Updated 2026 Guidance
section: The Company increased its 2026 guidance midpoints, raising the low end of its Normalized FFO and Normalized FAD estimates, and now projects net income attributable to CareTrust of approximately $1.50 to $1.51 per share, Normalized FFO of approximately $2.08 to $2.09 per share, and Normalized FAD of approximately $2.04 to $2.05 per share. Mr. Bunker commented, “The midpoints of our updated Normalized FFO and Normalized FAD guidance represent increases of 18.5% and 16.2%, respectively, over 2025 results. The new term loan and expanded revolver extend our runway and give us substantial capacity to fund the acquisition of the remaining LNT homes and the rest of our pipeline. With leverage well below our target range and multiple levers across our capital toolkit, we are well positioned to keep funding growth at our current pace."
Mr. Bunker noted that full year 2026 guidance is based on a weighted average diluted share count of 240 million shares, and assumes the following:
•No new investments, loans, or dispositions beyond those made or announced year-to-date;
•No new debt or equity issuances beyond those made year-to-date;
•2.5% inflation-based rent escalators under long-term triple net leases;
•$147 million of loans to be fully repaid throughout the year; and
